newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end up on payroll demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end up on payroll demand.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended higher on Tuesday due to increased demand for funds amid the peak of a routine monthly payroll, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 6.036 percent against Monday's 5.981 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.10-6.15 percent against 6.00-6.05.
Dealers expected the money rates to continue a minor upswing in the near term due to payroll demand.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0875 against Monday's 6.0860-0865 close. -James Lin (5080815)
